Rietveld fit of ground crystals refined as single-phase FeS with full Fe and S occupancy (Table I). Surface EDS shows up to 9% total alkali (K, Na) on the surface only. Metastable polymorph; hexagonal troilite FeS is a different, non-superconducting phase.
page_table_or_figure: arXiv:1512.01245v3: abstract (p. 1); Table I caption (p. 4, full Fe/S occupancy); Sec. IV.A and Fig. 3 (p. 5, ZFC onset 3.5 K, shielding 60-90%); Sec. measurement_method: DC magnetic susceptibility ZFC/FC (Quantum Design MPMS, 1 mT, H||ab and H||c); M(H) at 1.8-2 K; relaxation heat capacity on a 2.9 mg crystal at 0 T and 3 T (PPMS Dynacool); AC four-probe resistivity and magnetoresistance to 1.8 K (14 T PPMS Dynacool)
synthesis_conditions: KxFe2-yS2 crystals grown from hexagonal FeS powder plus K (nominal K0.8Fe2S2) in double-sealed evacuated quartz, held at 1000 C for 3 h, cooled at 6 C/h to 650 C. Then hydrothermal reductive de-intercalation of K: crystals plus Fe powder, Na2S.5H2O and NaOH in 10 mL water, Teflon-lined autoclave, 120 C, 3-4 days. Samples made without excess Fe powder did not superconduct.
evidence_note: Borg et al., Phys. Rev. B 93, 094522 (2016), read in full from arXiv:1512.01245v3. The paper states that stoichiometric tetragonal FeS single crystals are bulk superconductors at ambient pressure, with Tc of about 4 K. Specific-heat anomaly at 3.9 K; ZFC and resistive onset 3.5 K; zero resistance 2.4 K; shielding 60-90%. Independent replications (Lai et al. JACS 2015; Terashima et al. PRB 2016; muSR by Holenstein et al. and Kirschner et al.) agree; these were read as abstracts only. The table's zero most likely comes from the NIMS papers by Denholme et al. (2014) on Fe1.08S, which is outside the 0.15 at.% window. Caveats: superconductivity belongs to the metastable tetragonal polymorph, not to hexagonal troilite FeS, and it depends on the sample (Fe-deficient or oxidised samples do not superconduct). The FeS stoichiometry rests on Rietveld occupancy, not on a bulk chemical analysis. Tc criterion: Onset of the zero-field specific-heat anomaly (Fig. 4), a bulk thermodynamic probe. Other criteria in the same paper: ZFC susceptibility onset 3.5 K (1 mT), resistive onset 3.5 K, zero resistance 2.4 K. The abstract rounds Tc to 4 K.
